entities.name: Baru
entities.description: A druid of Krosa who seeks to follow his ancestor Kamahl.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Legendary barbarian and hero, Baru's ancestor, also Fist of Krosa.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forest on Dominaria devastated by an apocalypse and being restored.

events.summary: Baru and fellow druids worked to restore devastated Krosa, and wurms returned to hunt there.
events.quote: Baru and his fellow druids worked diligently to restore the region and return the forest to its former glory.

relations.quote: He shares the title of " Fist of Krosa " with his ancestor Kamahl .
